description: This file contains a set of Python functions and script logic for manipulating a virtual filesystem sandbox, including directory traversal, file creation, command execution, and atomic file operations. It appears to be a module for performing filesystem mutation actions within a sandboxed environment as part of a larger project.

methods.name: open_dir
methods.description: Opens a directory with specified flags.

methods.name: walk_parent
methods.description: Traverses a relative path from a root directory, optionally creating directories.

methods.name: create_temp_file
methods.description: Creates a uniquely named temporary file in a given directory.

methods.name: fd_path
methods.description: Returns a filesystem path for a given file descriptor, optionally appending a basename.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Executes a subprocess command with specified file descriptors passed.

methods.name: write_stdin_to_fd
methods.description: Reads binary data from stdin and writes it to a file descriptor.

methods.name: run_write
methods.description: Performs a write operation involving walking to a directory, creating a temp file, writing data, and atomically replacing the target file.

methods.name: run_mkdirp
methods.description: Creates a directory hierarchy and updates the filesystem accordingly.

methods.name: run_remove
methods.description: Removes a file or directory, with support for recursive and force options.

methods.name: run_rename
methods.description: Renames (moves) files or directories within the sandbox filesystem.
